key_insight: LLM-assisted redesign can match numerical-solver baselines in feasible design discovery with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs finding near-optimal solutions.
engineering_relevance: Combining engineering context from LLMs with black-box optimization can reduce simulation costs when adapting existing designs to changed requirements.
method: Integrate LLMs through warm starts, variable fixing, or ReAct.
Compare Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search, and random search.
Test electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization across four redesign scenario types.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparisons across three LLM integration methods and four black-box solvers, with benefits varying by requirement-change structure and LLM control over search.
watch_item: Results come from one battery pack case study, and the best integration strategy depends on the redesign scenario.
